key_points: Boundaries: define what you can and cannot do
Ask for help: specific asks get yeses; vague ones get sympathy
Key vocabulary: Respite — the planned caregiver break; Hospice — comfort care for end of life.
Governing principle: Write the plan down; memory fails under stress.
how_it_works: Working with The Future of Caregiving Basics in practice means applying Sustain method: schedule weekly respite, keep your own medical care, join a support group The practitioner keeps two reference facts at hand — Respite: the planned caregiver break; Hospice: comfort care for end of life — and checks each decision against the governing principles: Write the plan down; memory fails under stress.; Ask for specific help; people want to help but need direction..
